name: agentengram
description: Framework-neutral context and memory runtime for AI agents

scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @agentengram/engine test:coverage && pnpm --filter @agentengram/adapter-pi test:coverage && pnpm --filter @agentengram/adapter-codex test:coverage && pnpm --filter @agentengram/mcp test:coverage
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:package
scripts.check:release: pnpm check && pnpm check:privacy && pnpm check:privacy:history && AGENTENGRAM_INSTALL_SMOKE=1 pnpm test:install
